rationale: The paragraph gives the words of the article of amendment in the resolution sent from the Senate, as read in the message, and the words quoted (43 words) appear in the Eleventh Amendment.
to_quote: The Judicial power of the United States shall not be construed to extend to any suit in law or equity, commenced or prosecuted against one of the United States by Citizens of another State, or by Citizens or Subjects of any Foreign State
